correctness.rationale: Complete-multipartite adjacency makes the definition partwise: zeros in part i see weight W-w_i, while a positive vertex has positive support outside its part exactly when positive support meets at least two parts. The enumerator follows by exact inclusion-exclusion over support-deficient and outside-weight-one families. The only intersections of two latter families are weight-two labelings with one 1 in each of two non-singleton parts. Exhaustive direct checking confirms all coefficients through order nine.
